suggested_change: Criterion 4 should specify: Next steps must name a specific contact and include a concrete delivery date/deadline. Next steps are forward-looking actions, not backward verification questions. Example: 'Send [contact name] [deliverable] by [date] to enable them to present to [stakeholder] with follow-up call on [date].'
